$comment: Generated by 'npm run factory -- compile 080'. Do not edit by hand, except to set an AC's passes/evidence from a green CI run.
title: Agent lanes run capped and skip cleanly without credentials

tasks.title: Preflight decides run or skip per lane
Agent review and security review workflows
Doctor checks agent jobs and workflow hygiene; actionlint in static

acs.text: WHEN an agent lane's preflight runs and neither the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret nor the OIDC federation variables are configured THE SYSTEM SHALL skip the lane with a notice naming the missing secret and docs/runbooks/setup-checklist.md, write run=false, and exit 0
scenarios: AC-001 skip the lane with a notice naming the missing secret and docs/runbooks/setup-checklist.md

acs.text: WHEN a pull request comes from a fork THE SYSTEM SHALL skip the security review, whatever credentials exist
scenarios: AC-002 skip the security review, whatever credentials exist

acs.text: WHEN credentials are configured THE SYSTEM SHALL run the review lane with the model in the REVIEWER_MODEL variable, or an Opus-class default when it is unset
scenarios: AC-003 run the review lane with the model in the REVIEWER_MODEL variable, or an Opus-class defaul

acs.text: WHEN a workflow job runs an agent action without timeout-minutes, a --max-turns limit, a model, an allowed-tools list, a preflight gate, fork refusal or a commit-pinned action, or reads a secret other than the Anthropic key and the workflow token THE SYSTEM SHALL fail factory doctor with rule agent-jobs
scenarios: AC-004 fail factory doctor with rule agent-jobs

acs.text: WHEN a workflow job has no timeout-minutes, needs an unknown job, uses an unpinned third-party action, or reads the holdout deploy key outside nightly.yml or release.yml THE SYSTEM SHALL fail factory doctor with rule workflows
scenarios: AC-005 fail factory doctor with rule workflows

acs.text: WHEN each agent workflow's own preflight step is run with no secrets or variables set THE SYSTEM SHALL skip and exit 0 for every one of them
scenarios: AC-006 skip and exit 0 for every one of them
